instructions: Synthesizable Scaffold Hopping with Pharmacophore and Pocket-Interaction Retention. For the ERK2 instance, replace the supplied reference ligand's twenty-atom core while exactly preserving its entire eleven-atom meta-Cl/para-F sidechain, original attachment and native boundary stereochemistry. Design and rank up to ten distinct candidates, each with a fixed heavy-only pocket-frame pose, explicit core mapping and a graph route that independently replays from fourteen allowed starting graphs using four supplied reaction motif classes. Ordinary R-group modification, alternative SMILES, salt/protonation variants or heteroatom-only core edits do not count as new topology. Every candidate must pass explicit chemical/generic core change and no-old-core-embedding, distinct standardized Murcko/Morgan similarity<=0.5, seven-feature coherent spatial matching, three simultaneous same-assignment actual-H protein contacts, DG/planarity/protein-overlap checks, fixed Vina proxy<=-6.683 kcal/mol, and the specified RDKit Ro5-style property filter. The scorer never aligns, redocks, optimizes or repairs submitted heavy coordinates, never executes submitted code, and never trusts self-reported scores or route outcomes. The raw macro verified-scaffold-hop rate@10 counts at most one success per generic selected-core 2-core containment component per instance; missing ranks miss. This conservative grouping is top-set dependent, not a universal scaffold-equivalence claim. Research-time deterministic structure/pose/route feedback has trusted budgets100/50/20 with no-charge normal rejects and exact semantic caching; only test writes the official raw score. Preserve actual execution/error/retry evidence, but editable evidence and summary budget claims cannot override trusted VerifyContext history. Read scoring_and_protocol.md for all inclusive numerical gates, coordinate/state/stereo conventions, seven-file schemas, reaction scope, byte limits and feedback request format. All seven artifacts are required even for a zero-candidate submission. These computational routes and binding proxies are not experimental synthesis or measured binding evidence.

input.description: Reference chemical identities, coordinate-frame and preparation-state descriptions, data paths, and zero-based SDF atom indices corresponding to stable reference atom names. This file does not specify scoring gates.
The ERK2 reference ligand: one experimentally deposited conformer with its checked chemical graph and absolute stereochemistry, in the protein coordinate frame.

Observed ERK2 chain-A protein heavy atoms in the reference coordinate frame. Ligand, water, hydrogen and alternate conformations are removed; missing atoms remain missing. This is not a protonated or scoring-ready docking receptor.
Complete version-1 scientific gates, seven-artifact schemas, fixed-pose and exact-core conventions, graph reaction scope, and trusted research-feedback protocol.
Fourteen allowed starting graphs, including explicitly admitted prepared intermediates; identity does not assert supply, purity or experimental success.
Four ordered-role reaction SMARTS motif classes; new combinations are computational extrapolations, not exact laboratory recipes.
Fixed prepared ERK2 protein coordinates with hydrogens used for actual contact geometry; no candidate-dependent protonation or hydrogen optimization.
The exact fixed prepared rigid scoring receptor used by Vina score-only evaluation.

submission.description: Exact eleven-column header from the protocol; up to ten unique ranked candidates per instance, recomputed Murcko claim, unique route IDs and finite non-authoritative property claims.
One heavy-only fixed-pocket-frame pose per candidate, TASK_ID and RANK properties; original SDF indices bind the core map. Empty file for an empty candidate table.
Version1.0 candidates array with exact reference/candidate scaffold strings, retained/replaced/core atom IDs, attachment pairs and directed exit-vector pairs.
Version1.0 routes array; identifier-only ordered reaction DAGs with every intermediate and exact final state asserted for independent replay.
Version1.0 candidate-joined diagnostic feature/contact arrays; all success-relevant geometry is independently recomputed.
Strict finite JSON lines with kind/task_id/rank/artifact/note; actual execution/errors/retries/alternatives, never trusted as validation history.
Version1.0 recommendations array and non-authoritative budget_use object. Neither can override trusted state or scientific gates.

requirement: Exactly preserve all eleven specified retained atoms and native full-graph boundary stereochemistry; no sidechain-mask relaxation or Cl/F exchange.
Submit original heavy coordinates in the supplied protein frame; do not label computed poses, graph routes or binding proxies as experimental observations.
Only supplied material/template IDs establish route eligibility. Submitted SMARTS, executable code, claimed scores and pose labels are never executed or trusted.
Final scoring is local and offline. Trusted feedback counters cover validation observations, not arbitrary agent-local tool calls.
